title.purpose: Page-level heading only; 24px ceiling for the whole system.

label.purpose: Form labels, button text, nav tabs.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Barely-there lift separating Card White from App Canvas; no hover elevation change.

motion.name: color-step
motion.purpose: Only transition in the system: background/text color changes on hover and tab focus.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action button — submit forms, confirm, complete a trip.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0f172a; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1e293b; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Quiet destructive action — delete a row (truck, driver, zone, car).
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: #fef2f2; color: #b91c1c; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #fee2e2; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Trip status indicator — amber in progress, emerald completed.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-badge-amber { background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; } .ds-badge-emerald { background: #d1fae5; color: #065f46; } .ds-badge-slate { background: #f1f5f9; color: #334155; } .ds-badge-red { background: #fee2e2; color: #b91c1c; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field — plate, zone name, amount, email/password.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #0f172a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #0f172a; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The base surface for every section — forms, lists, the trip status readout.
components.html:
Camiones

components.name: Tab Nav
components.description: Admin panel section switcher — Camiones / Choferes / Zonas / Viajes / Usuarios.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; } .ds-tab { padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #64748b; background: none; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #334155; } .ds-tab-active { color: #0f172a; border-bottom-color: #0f172a; }

narrative.overview: A clipboard, not a showroom. This is an internal ops tool for one car-hauling business — the two people using it (dispatch staff at a desk, drivers on a phone) need to read a status, find a button, and move on. The system deliberately withholds decoration: one neutral ink color for structure and action, three semantic colors reserved strictly for trip status (in progress / completed / destructive), and nothing else competing for attention. Whitespace and hairline borders do the organizing work that color would do in a consumer product. Nothing here is provisional-looking or unfinished — the restraint is the choice, not a placeholder for a future rebrand. If this system ever gets a real brand pass, the ink-slate primary is the one color to replace; everything else (status colors, neutral scale) is functional and should survive unchanged.
keyCharacteristics: Single ink-slate (#0f172a) as the only color with authority — it is text, primary buttons, and active tab state, never anything else.
Status color (amber = in progress, emerald = completed, red = destructive) never appears outside a Badge or a delete affordance.
Flat cards on a barely-tinted app background (#f8fafc vs #ffffff) — the only depth cue in the system.
Dense, left-aligned, form-first layouts. No hero sections, no marketing rhythm.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Ink Slate is the only color allowed to mean "this is interactive and important." If a second color starts appearing on primary buttons or active nav, the system has drifted.

rules.name: The Status-Only Rule
rules.body: Amber, emerald, and red never appear as decoration. Amber = trip in progress, emerald = trip completed, red = a destructive action or an error message. No other use is permitted, ever.

rules.name: The No-Display-Type Rule
rules.body: There is no hero/display scale in this system. 24px is the ceiling.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from the App Canvas / Card White contrast and hairline borders first; shadow is a secondary, barely-perceptible reinforcement, never the primary depth cue.

rules.name: The Nesting Radius Rule
rules.body: A control nested inside a larger rounded surface uses an equal or smaller radius than its parent — never larger.

dos: Do keep Ink Slate as the only color used for primary actions and active navigation state.
Do reserve amber/emerald/red strictly for trip status and destructive actions.
Do use hairline borders + the App Canvas/Card White contrast as the primary depth cue before reaching for shadow.
Do keep nested radii equal to or smaller than their parent container's radius.
Do design the driver surface for one-handed phone use first.
donts: Don't introduce a second "important" color alongside Ink Slate.
Don't add hover elevation/lift to cards or buttons.
Don't invent sample fleet, driver, or trip data to demo the UI.
Don't add a display/hero type scale; 24px is the largest text this system uses anywhere.
